create_policy: create a Policy instance with a neural network backbone and action dimension for RL navigation
build_audio_nav_baseline_policy: build an AudioNavBaselinePolicy with observation space, action space, and goal sensor UUID for audio-guided navigation
build_audio_nav_smt_policy: build an AudioNavSMTPolicy using Scene Memory Transformer with observation and action spaces for memory-based navigation
test_critic_head: test the CriticHead value estimation module that maps feature vectors to scalar value predictions
